description: Image Description: The image depicts a serene coastal scene during sunset. The foreground features a surfboard lying on wet, reflective sand, which indicates the tide is out. The surfboard is positioned horizontally, with its leash visible. The background showcases a horizon with a beautiful sunset, where the sun is partially obscured by clouds, casting a warm glow across the sky. The water reflects the colors of the sunset, creating a peaceful and picturesque atmosphere. There are silhouettes of trees and land formations in the distance
